for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line[2:]
        # Split by " BY " to get title and rest
        parts = line.split(' BY ')
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title = parts[0].strip()
            rest = parts[1].strip()
            # Remove " RELEASED_AT TODO" from rest
            artists_str = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '').strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            songs_todo.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(songs_todo)
